fyp15_discrepancies.official_text: Plan table p.10: "执业医师数（人） 3.1 3.7 —". NHC 2025年我国卫生健康事业发展统计公报 (2026-08-28), 表2: "#每千人口执业医师（人） 3.04 3.25" (2024, 2025); text: "2025年，每千人口执业（助理）医师3.78人，每千人口执业医师3.25人".
fyp15_discrepancies.comment: The dataset transcribes the plan table correctly (3.1). But the plan's 2025 column was a preliminary figure: the NHC final 2025 value for the same indicator (执业医师, excl. assistants) is 3.25 per 1,000 (2024: 3.04). Keep 3.1 as the plan baseline, but note that the official 2025 outcome is 3.25 and that progress toward 3.7 should be scored against NHC bulletins, not the plan column.

fyp15_discrepancies.official_text: Plan table: "注册护士数（人） 4.3 5.1 —". NHC 2025 bulletin 表2: "每千人口注册护士（人） 4.16 4.32".
fyp15_discrepancies.comment: Consistent (4.32 rounds to 4.3). No change needed; NHC gives two decimals.

fyp15_discrepancies.official_text: "7.城镇调查失业率（%） 5.2 — ＜5.5 预期性" — 5.2 is in the 2025 column; ＜5.5 is in the 年均/累计 column; the 2030 column is "—".
fyp15_discrepancies.comment: Add baseline {year 2025, value 5.2}. The ＜5.5 is an annual ceiling for every year 2026–2030 (年均/累计 column), not a 2030 level; consider kind 'threshold' with period 2026–2030 rather than target.year 2030.

fyp15_discrepancies.dataset_value: no baseline field (9.1 only in note); target {2030: 7}, target_text ">7"
fyp15_discrepancies.official_text: "4.全社会研发经费投入增长（%） 9.1 — ＞7 预期性" with note ③全社会研发经费投入增速按不变价格计算。
fyp15_discrepancies.comment: 9.1 is printed in the 2025 column (2025 growth rate); ＞7 is in the 年均/累计 column (average annual growth 2026–2030). Dataset reading is correct; suggest recording baseline {2025: 9.1} explicitly and clarifying that 7 is a period-average rate, not a 2030 value.

fyp15_discrepancies.dataset_value: 每千人口拥有执业医师数
fyp15_discrepancies.official_text: "10.每千人口拥有医护人员数" / sub-row "执业医师数（人）"
fyp15_discrepancies.comment: Paraphrase of the parent + sub-row label. Acceptable; could be written 每千人口拥有医护人员数（执业医师数） for fidelity. Same applies to fyp15_nurses (注册护士数).

fyp15_discrepancies.dataset_value: Unit changed from 亿吨 to 万亿斤 (1.39 万亿斤 ≈ 6.95 亿吨).
fyp15_discrepancies.official_text: "19.粮食综合生产能力（万亿斤） 1.39 1.45左右 — 约束性"; note ④粮食综合生产能力指可以稳定达到的粮食产出能力。 2026 政府工作报告: "粮食产量达到1.43万亿斤" (2025 output).
fyp15_discrepancies.comment: Values match. Add footnote ④: the indicator is stable production capacity, not actual output (2025 output was 1.43 万亿斤), so NBS grain-output figures should not be scored directly against 1.39/1.45.

fyp15_discrepancies.official_text: "14.单位GDP二氧化碳排放降低（%） 〔17.7〕 — 〔17〕 约束性"
fyp15_discrepancies.comment: Confirmed: the 2025 column prints the five-year cumulative 2021–2025 reduction 〔17.7〕 and the 年均/累计 column prints the 2026–2030 target 〔17〕. The dataset's use of 17.7 as the fyp14_co2_intensity 2025 actual (attributed to this table) is correct. Suggest adding a note to fyp15_co2_intensity that 〔17.7〕 is the printed 14th-FYP outcome.

fyp15_discrepancies.official_text: "12. 3岁以下婴幼儿入托率提高（百分点） — — 〔6〕 预期性"
fyp15_discrepancies.comment: No 2025 level is printed (both 2025 and 2030 columns are —). Baseline 0 is a modelling convention, correctly flagged in the note. No official 2025 入托率 level is printed in the table.

fyp15_discrepancies.official_text: Table has no row for 单位GDP能耗/能源消耗; row 15 非化石能源占能源消费总量比重 21.7 → 25 约束性. The 14th FYP outline already set 非化石能源 20%左右 in Chapter 11 (not in its 专栏1).
fyp15_discrepancies.comment: Wording: the 15th FYP table drops the 单位GDP能耗 row (no energy-intensity indicator anywhere in the table) and elevates non-fossil share into the headline table as binding. 'Replaces' is a reasonable shorthand but the note should say the energy-intensity row was removed rather than renamed.

fyp15_discrepancies.official_text: NDRC PDF https://www.ndrc.gov.cn/fggz/fzzlgh/gjfzgh/202603/U020260317369114704096.pdf, 专栏1 on p.10, text-extractable.
fyp15_discrepancies.comment: Add the NDRC PDF (p.10) as the citable text source for the table; keep gov.cn as the publication record.

fyp15_discrepancies.official_text: Table has 20 numbered rows (21 lines incl. the nurse sub-row). Rows not in dataset: 1 GDP增长 (保持在合理区间、各年度视情提出), 2 全员劳动生产率增长 (高于GDP增长), 8 居民人均可支配收入增长 (与GDP增长同步).
fyp15_discrepancies.comment: Omitted rows have qualitative targets; omission is defensible but should be stated in the plan note so the '18 of 20' coverage is transparent.

fyp15_discrepancies.target_id: fyp15_life_expectancy / fyp15_forest_cover / fyp15_pm25 / fyp15_good_water / fyp15_grain_capacity / fyp15_energy_capacity / fyp15_urbanization / fyp15_hv_patents / fyp15_digital_core_share / fyp15_schooling / fyp15_nursing_beds
fyp15_discrepancies.official_text: Identical to the printed cells (see fyp15_table).
fyp15_discrepancies.comment: No discrepancy. Attributes (约束性/预期性) all match. Note 2025 values 10.5* and 25.1* are 2024 data (②).

source.title: 应变克难开新局 凝心聚力谱华章——"十四五"经济社会发展成就系列报告之一 (NBS, 2026-06-02)
source.quote: "十四五"以来，基本养老保险参保率超过95%，基本医疗保险参保率稳定在95%左右。

new_actuals.note: FLOOR value ('超过95%'), period stated as '十四五以来' (not a dated 2025 point). Corroborated by NDRC Director 郑栅洁 at the SCIO press conference 2025-07-09 (ndrc.gov.cn transcript): "义务教育巩固率和基本养老保险、基本医疗保险参保率都在95%以上" and by MOHRSS Minister 王晓萍 2025-09-26 (Xinhua): "参保率从91%提高到95%以上" (as of end-Aug 2025). No official point estimate of the rate was located; MOHRSS 2025年度统计公报 page could not be fetched (mohrss.gov.cn returns empty/403).

not_found.what_was_tried: MOHRSS 2025年度人力资源和社会保障事业发展统计公报: mohrss.gov.cn index pages (/zwgk/szrs/, /tjgb/) return empty content to WebFetch and 403 to curl; no gov.cn mirror found before the search budget ran out. Only floors exist: NBS 十四五 report No.1 '超过95%'; NDRC transcript 2025-07-09 '95%以上'; MOHRSS minister 2025-09-26 (Xinhua) '95%以上' (end-Aug 2025). Participant counts (NBS 2025 communiqué): 107599万 total, 54680万 城镇职工, 52919万 城乡居民; the denominator (legally covered population) is not published, so the rate cannot be computed transparently.
NHC 2022年我国卫生健康事业发展统计公报 (gov.cn PDF) contains no 人均预期寿命 sentence; NBS 75-year health report jumps from 2021 (78.2) to 2023 (78.6); no official 2022 value found.

NBS commentary 2022-01-18 (王萍萍) gives only the 2020 census value 10.75; the 2023-01-18 commentary says 2022 = 10.93 '比2021年提高0.11年' but does not print the 2021 level (≈10.82 by implication — not recorded per rule 1). MOE 教育统计公报 does not publish this indicator.

forestry.gov.cn 国土绿化公报 column lists only the 2020 bulletin; 2022年中国国土绿化状况公报 (24.02%) not located on a gov.cn host before the search budget ran out. Existing China Daily (Tier C) source remains; value should stay flagged 'medium' or be set null pending an NFGA/gov.cn copy.

2025年中国国土绿化状况公报 (NFGA, March 2026) not located; forestry.gov.cn navigation gives no link. Official statements are floors only: 2026 政府工作报告 '森林覆盖率提高到25%以上'; NBS 十四五 report No.1 (2026-06-02) '目前森林覆盖率超25%，比2020年提高约2个百分点'.

Looked for a cac.gov.cn or nda.gov.cn original of the 8.23亿 figure; nda.gov.cn renders no content to WebFetch; CAC 2025 IPv6 coordination-meeting page not located. Existing source (数字中国发展报告（2024年） copy on zsj.nmg.gov.cn, p.11: '截至2024年底，IPv6活跃用户数达8.23亿') is a *.gov.cn-hosted copy → Tier B/medium; value confirmed.

工业互联网平台应用普及率: not reported in 数字中国发展报告 2021/2022/2024 (they give platform counts and connected devices only); no MIIT statistical release of this indicator located. The indicator is produced by CAICT (Tier C). Also 2021–2024 not found.

数字中国发展报告（2024年） has no 实名用户 count; 数字中国发展报告（2025年） PDF not located on nda.gov.cn (JS-rendered site); gjzwfw.www.gov.cn shows no user statistic. Also 2023 and 2024 not found. Only floors exist (2021 and 2022 '超过10亿人').
NBS final 2025 accounting not yet published (expected ~Dec 2026); only the Government Work Report floor '10.5%以上' (recorded under replacements).

No NBS/MEE sentence stating a 2021–2025 cumulative CO2-intensity reduction was found; the only official cumulative figure is the 〔17.7〕 printed in the 15th FYP table (recorded under replacements with the NDRC PDF).

definition_notes.note: 14th FYP indicator = 每千人口拥有执业（助理）医师数 (incl. assistant physicians). 15th FYP switched to 执业医师数 (excl. assistants). NHC bulletins publish both: 2024 3.61 / 3.04; 2025 3.78 / 3.25. Headcounts differ slightly between NBS communiqué (preliminary, 529万 in 2025) and NHC bulletin (final, 530.6万); use the NHC per-1,000 ratio directly.

Plan table 2025 column (3.1) is lower than the NHC final 2025 value (3.25) for the same definition; the plan column appears to be a pre-publication estimate. Score 2026–2030 progress against NHC bulletins.

Annual NBS communiqué sentences: 2021 "全年全国万元国内生产总值能耗比上年下降2.7%"; 2022 "全年全国万元国内生产总值能耗比上年下降0.1%"; 2023 "初步测算，扣除原料用能和非化石能源消费量后，全国万元国内生产总值能耗比上年下降0.5%"; 2024 "扣除原料用能和非化石能源消费量后，全国万元国内生产总值能耗比上年下降3.8%"; 2025 "初步测算，扣除原料用能和非化石能源消费量后，全国万元国内生产总值能耗比上年下降5.1%" (all 按2020年价格计算). DEFINITION CHANGE from the 2023 communiqué onward (feedstock energy and non-fossil consumption excluded). Official cumulative figures, both on the adjusted basis: 2021–2024 −11.6% (NDRC 2025-07-09 transcript; white paper 2025-11-08) and 2021–2025 −16.1% (NBS 2026-06-05). The 2026 政府工作报告 gives only the 2025 annual figure ("单位国内生产总值能耗降低5.1%"). Do not compound the annual series.

Annual NBS communiqué sentences: 2021 "全国万元国内生产总值二氧化碳排放下降3.8%"; 2022 "全国万元国内生产总值二氧化碳排放下降0.8%"; 2023 "全年全国万元国内生产总值二氧化碳排放与上年持平"; 2024 "全年全国万元国内生产总值二氧化碳排放比上年下降3.4%"; 2025 "初步测算，全年全国万元国内生产总值二氧化碳排放比上年下降5.0%". Official cumulative 2021–2025: 〔17.7〕 printed in the 15th FYP table (NDRC PDF p.10). MEE 2022 NDC progress report: 2021 carbon intensity −3.8% vs 2020 and −50.8% vs 2005; MEE 2023-10-27: 2022 '较2005年下降超过51%'.

NBS measures the non-fossil share as 一次电力及其他能源占能源消费总量比重. The 2020 baseline was revised from 15.9% (NEA at the time) to 16.0% (white paper 2025-11-08; NBS 2026). Series now fully official: 2020 16.0, 2021 16.6, 2022 17.5, 2023 17.9, 2024 19.8, 2025 21.7. Note the NBS communiqués' '清洁能源消费量占比' (25.5/25.9/26.4/28.6/30.4%) INCLUDES natural gas and is a different indicator.

基本养老保险参保率 = participants / legally covered population; MOHRSS does not publish the denominator in its communiqués. NBS 2025 communiqué: "年末全国参加基本养老保险人数107599万人，比上年末增加316万人，其中参加城镇职工基本养老保险人数54680万人，参加城乡居民基本养老保险人数52919万人。" All official rate statements are floors ('超过95%' / '95%以上').

NBS definition: 16—59岁劳动年龄人口平均受教育年限. NBS commentaries give two decimals (2020 10.75, 2022 10.93, 2023 11.05, 2024 11.21); the 2025 communiqué and plan table give one decimal (11.3). The GWR and plan table phrase it 劳动年龄人口平均受教育年限 — same indicator.

每千人口拥有3岁以下婴幼儿托位数 is places per 1,000 TOTAL population (not per 1,000 children). Official series: 2021 2.03, 2022 2.57, 2023 3.38, 2024 4.08, 2025 4.73 (target 4.5 met). The 15th FYP replaced this with an enrolment-rate gain 〔6〕 percentage points; no official 2025 入托率 level is printed in the plan table.

MEE reports two variants: the headline 优良天数比例 and a value 扣除沙尘异常超标天后 (2023: 85.5% vs 86.8%; 2025: 88.1% vs 89.3%). The 14th FYP target (87.5) refers to the headline value. Annual release titles vary ('通报' vs '公布').

2024 = 25.09% (white paper; printed as 25.1* in the plan table). Forest cover is published in the NFGA 国土绿化状况公报 each March and in forest-resource monitoring; the jump above 25% from 2023 reflects the new survey base. 2025 is only available as a floor (>25%).

GWR 2026 and NBS 十四五 report give only '10.5%以上' / '超过10.5%' for 2025 (preliminary). NBS releases the accounting result with a one-year lag (2024 value 10.5% released 2025-12-30). Note that the NDRC 2025-07-09 transcript cited 2024 as '占GDP比重达到10.4%', superseded by NBS 10.5%.

NHC publishes life expectancy irregularly in its annual bulletin (2021 78.2; 2022 not published; 2023 78.6; 2024 79.0; 2025 79.25). The 14th FYP target was a cumulative gain 〔1〕 on 77.3 (2019); 2025 outcome 79.25 exceeds the implied 78.3.
Official reports give only floors ('超过10亿人' in 2021 and 2022 数字中国发展报告); the 2024 report gives no user count. Indicator name in the plan: 在线政务服务实名用户规模.
工业互联网平台应用普及率 is a CAICT-defined survey indicator (baseline 14.7% 2020); no ministry statistical release found for 2021–2025. Leave actuals null.
Footnote ④: 粮食综合生产能力指可以稳定达到的粮食产出能力 — a capacity concept; 2025 grain OUTPUT was 1.43万亿斤 (2026 政府工作报告), above the 1.39 capacity printed in the table.
51.3 (2025) equals NBS's 一次能源生产总量51.3亿吨标准煤 (十四五 report No.14: "2025年，全国一次能源生产总量51.3亿吨标准煤，比2020年增长27.3%").
